text:
Thanks for checking, and great question! 🌿

If you wait until tonight (about 5 hours from now), you'll be past the **2-hour window** for free online changes. Once that passes, your order goes into the packing queue and can't be edited in "My Orders".

- Support can **try** to intercept the order before it ships, but this isn't guaranteed.
- Chat is open 8am-8pm Mon-Sat (your local time), so it may be closed by tonight. Email (help@leafy.example) is answered within 1 business day, which might be too slow if your order ships first.

**If you can, add the pot within the next 1 hour 40 minutes.** That's the only way to be sure it's covered. Just check that "My Orders" shows an option to add an item, as I can't confirm that from my end.

If you miss the window, you could place a **separate order** for the pot. I can't promise it would ship together with your ZZ plant, and standard shipping is $7.95 (free on orders of $75+, after discounts and before tax). If you'd like, I can also look into whether support can intercept your original order, though I can't promise the outcome.

Happy planting, and please reach out any time! 🌱
